_schema: Per-country boundary tolerance for the cross-border substation gate (Discipline #36).
_purpose: Override the default 100m boundary-precision tolerance per country where the bounds.json polygon resolution is known to produce false-positive outlier flags (Failure mode 2 per CROSS_BORDER_SUBSTATION_AUDIT_20260618.md). The tolerance is the maximum acceptable distance from the polygon boundary at which a substation is still considered 'inside' — set to a value that absorbs the coastline-simplification error specific to each country's source polygon.
_methodology_note: Per-country tolerance is the transparent alternative to refreshing each country's bounds.json against Natural Earth 10m source data. Tolerance + rationale published openly; the polygon precision is declared rather than hidden. Source-data refresh remains the longer-term work for the per-country Phase 2 pass.

greenland.rationale: Heavily indented fjord coastline; bounds.json derived from Natural Earth 50m simplification. 100% of audit outliers sit within 5 km of polygon edge. Real Greenlandic substations on coastal fjord settlements (Ilulissat, Sisimiut, Nuuk, etc.). Clears 31 of 31 audit outliers; max observed drift 4.6 km.

new-zealand.rationale: Heavily indented Pacific coastline (North Cape, East Cape, Coromandel, Fiordland, Stewart Island); bounds.json simplified at sub-cadastral precision. 100% of audit outliers sit within 5 km of polygon edge. Clears 101 of 101 audit outliers; max observed drift 3.8 km.

denmark.rationale: Coastal + offshore-wind territorial-waters allowance. 105 of 123 audit outliers within 5 km coastline tolerance. Remaining 18 outliers between 5-34 km include offshore wind transformer platforms (Anholt Havmøllepark in Kattegat, Horns Rev). Offshore wind platforms are legitimate Danish substations in Danish EEZ; explicit allowance pending bounds.json maritime polygon extension in Phase 2.

norway.rationale: Norwegian fjord coastline; bounds.json simplified. 811 of 1,464 outliers within 5 km coastline tolerance. Remaining 653 outliers split into: Svalbard (already in bounds.json, may need separate polygon-edge refresh) + Swedish-side substations misattributed at ingestion (Mode 1 remediation queued separately).

greece.rationale: Aegean archipelago + Ionian islands + Crete + heavily indented Peloponnese/mainland Mediterranean coastline; bounds.json 14-polygon multi-region file with simplified island edges. Wave 3 P22 preflight tolerance set at 5 km per Greenland/NZ/Denmark/Norway coastline-tolerance precedent. Turkish border in Thrace + Albanian/North Macedonian/Bulgarian northern borders precision preserved; Aegean maritime EEZ boundaries excluded from filter scope. Expected pre-filter substation drift <2% pre-fetch; audit at Step 4 merge time.

iceland.rationale: Heavily indented fjord coastline (Westfjords + Eastfjords) + Vestmannaeyjar (Westman Islands) offshore offset + Grímsey Arctic Circle offshore island + volcanic geothermal remote-siting; bounds.json 8-polygon statistical-region file with simplified coastal edges. Wave 3 P23 preflight tolerance set at 5 km per Greenland/NZ/Denmark/Norway coastline-tolerance precedent (sibling Nordic islands). Iceland is fully-isolated grid (no submarine interconnector to Europe) — no cross-border legitimate substations exist; tolerance is purely for coastline precision + offshore-island offset absorption. Expected pre-filter substation drift <1% pre-fetch; audit at Step 4 merge time.

switzerland.rationale: Alpine ridge-line borders with FR/DE/IT/AT/LI (1739 km international border ~4× Nordic-island coastline scale); bounds.json 26-polygon canton-partition file with simplified Alpine mountain-ridge boundaries. Switzerland has 41 cross-border interconnectors — HIGHEST cohort-wide — meaning legitimate near-border TSO substations exist at every interconnector. Tolerance set at 0.5 km (5× cadastral default) to absorb Alpine terrain simplification without dropping legitimate Swissgrid cross-border substations. Enclaves (Büsingen DE inside Schaffhausen + Campione d'Italia IT inside Ticino) preserve their host-country attribution architecturally — Swiss bounds polygon excludes them. Expected pre-filter substation drift 0.5-2% pre-fetch (higher than Iceland's 0.45% due to Alpine border complexity + high cross-border density); audit at Step 4 merge time.

ireland.rationale: Atlantic coastline complexity (Ring of Kerry + Wild Atlantic Way peninsulas + Aran Islands + Achill Island offshore offsets) + 3 major cross-border interconnectors (Moyle HVDC 500 MW to Scotland + East-West HVDC 500 MW to Wales + Northern Ireland AC land border ~500 km); bounds.json 26-polygon Republic-of-Ireland county-partition file with simplified Atlantic-coast boundaries. Northern Ireland land border pre-excluded via Republic-only polygon (SONI + NIE Networks operate in NI scope). Tolerance set at 1.0 km (10× cadastral default) to absorb Atlantic coastline simplification + HVDC-terminal precision without dropping legitimate EirGrid cross-border substations. Post-Brexit unique cohort position: EU member coordinating with GB non-EU via SEM/I-SEM. Expected pre-filter substation drift 0.3-1.5% pre-fetch (moderate Atlantic complexity; NI border pre-excluded via bounds.json); audit at Step 4 merge time.

korea.rationale: KR-ISOLATED grid — NO cross-border interconnector (DMZ northern boundary at ~38.3°N pre-excluded via bounds.json 17-region South-Korea-only polygon covering DPRK entirely; no submarine link to Japan or China). Coastal complexity absorbs ~4,400 offshore islands (Jeju + Ulleungdo + Dokdo + Marado + Baengnyeongdo + others) with heavily indented Republic-of-Korea coastline (Rias-type southern + smooth western + volcanic eastern). bounds.json 17-polygon do/si first-tier admin file with simplified coastal boundaries. Tolerance set at 5.0 km (50× cadastral default) per Iceland-analog sibling isolated-grid precedent (Nordic + Korean isolated grids share coastline simplification pattern). Jeju HVDC interconnector (3 submarine cables Jeju↔Haenam totalling 900 MW) is DOMESTIC (Jeju is Korean territory), NOT cross-border. FIRST Asian Wave 3 event + 3rd cohort-wide non-cross-border grid (after Iceland + Greenland). Expected pre-filter substation drift <0.5% pre-fetch (KEPCO monopoly + KR-ISOLATED signature); audit at Step 4 merge time.

_phase_2_note: Mode 3 territorial gaps (Canadian Arctic, UK Northern Ireland, French DOM-TOM, Chilean Patagonian islands) and pure Mode 1 cases (Canada US-side, UK European-side mis-coords, France Spanish-side, Chile Argentinian-side, Norway Swedish-side) are handled by scripts/remediate_cross_border.py substation removal rather than tolerance — see MODE_2_3_FOLLOWON_PLAN.md.
